title: Wire token budgeting into prompt layer assembly in chatbot/core/prompt_layers.py
description:
Modify chatbot/core/prompt_layers.py to integrate the dynamic token budget calculator and adapt the prompt layer system to respect the allocated token budget. Also ensure it supports formatting from the attention anchoring system.

Before editing, inspect:
- chatbot/core/prompt_layers.py
- chatbot/core/token_budget.py
- chatbot/core/attention_anchor.py
acceptance_criteria: Prompt layer assembly enforces the computed token budget bounds
